title: Harden the help desk inbound flow
scenario: Larkspur Financial Group is moving its IT service desk from Avaya vectors to Amazon Connect. The contractor's first inbound flow drops callers: a slow directory lookup hangs the IVR, wrong keys loop forever, VIPs queue behind everyone and nobody can report an outage after hours. Author the flow-language JSON so it passes the team's graph lint and the call-path regression suite.
task: Identify caller in <= 3 s, degrade to unverified on any error
Bounded menu retries with Loop, VIP and outage at queue priority 1
Password-reset self-service with fallback to the PasswordReset queue
Staffing check with overflow; QueueAtCapacity and error handling on transfer
Explain budgets, fallbacks and production follow-ups in ANSWER.md
acceptance: make lint clean: error branches, no dead ends, bounded loops, attributes set before use, working queue before transfer
Every synchronous Lambda <= 8 s with an error branch
Call-path suite passes: menu, retries, VIP, outage, identify error/slow, reset outcomes, overflow, capacity, after-hours
No employee identifier read back in a prompt

practices.label: Week 1 Tue - flow language, modules and error handling
Week 1 Wed - queues, routing profiles and priority
Week 1 Thu - Lambda in flows: sync 8 s vs async 60 s
